name: Cocoa powder (defatted press cake, ground)
source: Defatted cocoa press cake, ground: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 30 g, protein 196 g, fat 137 g (residual press fat, typical of natural/unsweetened cocoa powder), carbohydrate 579 g, ash 58 g (USDA FoodData Central pattern for unsweetened cocoa powder).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Grinding the press cake into powder is a pure phase change with no further mass loss, so this one file covers both.
